suggestions: reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, cd.cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM customer c
INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS store_customer_sk
        FROM store_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim AS d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
        WHERE d1.d_year = 2002 AND d1.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) AS store_cust
    WHERE store_cust.store_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS web_customer_sk
        FROM web_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim AS d2 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_year = 2002 AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) AS web_cust
    WHERE web_cust.web_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS catalog_customer_sk
        FROM catalog_sales
        INNER JOIN date_dim AS d3 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
        WHERE d3.d_year = 2002 AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) AS catalog_cust
    WHERE catalog_cust.catalog_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
